_note: Starting stats per playable character record (table at ROM 0x6FDA4C, 9 x 18 bytes: u16 level, u16 HP, u16 EP, u8 STR, POW, END, SPD, 8 unknown bytes). Record 0 = Goku (the player slot Gero uses in Act 1). Level is the displayed level; the EXP table starts at level 50, so 50 is the lowest safe value.
